title: Customer 360
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Lifetime revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.customer_id = 1017

kpis.label: Orders
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = 1017

kpis.label: Open invoices
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE customer_id = 1017 AND status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid')

kpis.label: Tickets not closed
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets WHERE customer_id = 1017 AND status <> 'closed'

kpis.label: Care plan MRR
kpis.sql: SELECT round(coalesce(sum(mrr), 0), 2) FROM dash_demo.subscriptions WHERE customer_id = 1017 AND cancel_date IS NULL

kpis.label: Tickets
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets WHERE customer_id = 1017
